The '''spiny urchin''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It had a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous sting]] that could incapacitate an individual. [[Spodan]], one of [[Karak]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], attempted to use a spiny urchin to stun a member of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team during the [[Battle of Fitsay|battle]] of [[Fitsay]].<ref name="BGS" />
